confidence_notes: Two web searches were run: one for the RBA rate and one for Pushkar food and drink prices. The RBA figure of 0.6720 USD per AUD for 18 November 2026 came from a search summary that pointed to the RBA exchange-rates page. It was not read directly from that page. The meal and coffee anchors are based on aggregated traveler and cost-of-living figures: an inexpensive meal at about $2, a cappuccino at about $1.50, and a mid-range meal for two at about INR 500 to 1,000. They are rounded up a little for July 2026 and for tourist cafes. Pushkar is a holy town where alcohol and meat are officially banned. No reliable local beer price was found. Beer, cocktail and wine are estimates based on prices in nearby Ajmer and Rajasthan, with a markup for discreet or outskirts resort service. Cocktail and wine are set from their usual ratio to beer in India, so all three are very uncertain. July is the low monsoon season. The accommodation anchors are model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings. The search summary also mentioned dorm beds at about $3 and private rooms at about $23, which was not used directly. Prices can rise sharply during the Pushkar Camel Fair in October and November.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with backpacker-heavy small tourist towns in Rajasthan and North India, such as Ajmer, Bundi, Rishikesh (which also has alcohol and meat restrictions) and budget parts of Udaipur.
